title: Recommender Comparison Tool
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare possible teacher recommenders on how well they know you, how recently they taught you, subject, and reliability, and see which two would write the strongest, most complementary letters.

learningObjectives: Students will compare potential recommenders on how well they know the student, recency, subject, and reliability, and choose two teachers whose letters will be specific and complementary.

controls: Subject, grade taught, and your grade dropdowns
Add teacher, Remove selected, two presets, and Clear buttons

keyQuestions: Why does how well a teacher knows you matter more than the grade you earned?
Why are 11th-grade teachers usually the best choice?
When might a teacher from an elective be a good additional recommender?
commonMisconceptions: The teacher who gave you the highest grade writes the best letter.
Both letters should come from your intended major's subject.
assessmentOpportunities: Students choose two recommenders for a scenario and justify the choice using how well each knows them and what each letter would add.
